title: UP Police Home Guard Recruitment 2025 Exam PET Admit Card 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment & Promotion Board (UPPRPB)
qualification: Class 10th / Matric passed from a recognized board.
ageLimit: 18 to 30 years as on 01 July 2025. Age relaxation extra as per UP Police Home Guard recruitment rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 400; SC / ST: Rs. 300. Pay through e-Challan, debit card, credit card or net banking as applicable.
selectionProcess: Written examination -> DV / PST -> PET / PST -> Final selection as per UP Police Home Guard rules.
documentsRequired: Registration number, application details, photo ID, admit card, educational certificate, category certificate if applicable and other documents mentioned in the notice.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppbpb.gov.in
2. Open the UP Police Home Guard Recruitment / Admit Card section
3. Use the relevant login link with registration number and date of birth or password
4. Download and print the admit card, city slip or notice
5. Carry the printed admit card and valid photo ID to the exam venue
shortDescription: UP Police Home Guard Recruitment 2025 PET admit card released on 13 September 2026 for the PET/PST stage. Check the 41,424-post schedule, notices and official download links.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment & Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has released the PET / PST Admit Card for UP Police Home Guard Recruitment 2025 under Advt. No. 02/2025.

The recruitment includes 41,424 Home Guard posts. The PET / PST stage starts from 15 September 2026, and the admit card is available from 13 September 2026. Candidates should download the hall ticket and check the allotted date, venue, reporting time and instructions.

Important schedule

  • Application: 17 November 2025 to 17 December 2025
  • Written exam: 25 to 27 April 2026
  • Written result: 28 June 2026
  • DV / PST: 13 July 2026 to 07 August 2026
  • DV / PST admit card: 06 July 2026
  • PET / PST starts: 15 September 2026
  • PET / PST admit card: 13 September 2026

Use the official UP Home Guard examination portal for the PET admit card and UPPRPB notices for the latest schedule or postponement updates.

importantDates.examDate: 25 to 27 April 2026; PET / PST from 15 September 2026
